description: Price a sponsorship for the creator: a low to high range and the ask Snippet recommends, from their real measured views on that platform against published CPM benchmarks, never below their minimum. Pass the brand's offer to hear whether to take it or counter, and usage rights or exclusivity to get add-on guidance. Use it when the creator asks what to charge, whether an offer is fair, or what a package is worth. For a deal already in Snippet, get_deal has its recommended rate. Read-only.
